title: 'Tell me about yourself' by type family
caption:
'So, tell me about yourself.' Cue panic.

The most common interview question trips up every type differently. Thinkers lecture, the heart-led tell their life story, guardians recite their CV and makers say 'umm, I'm a hands-on person'. Here's the trap and the fix for each family.

Save this before your next interview, and share it with someone job hunting.
